name: The Legend of Banjo-Kazooie: The Bear Waker Deluxe
summary:
Bear Waker Deluxe was released as an updated version of Mark Kurko's original Bear Waker mod, approximately 5 years after its original release.

Updates from the original version:

* Several bugs fixed

* Several extra maps

* More than 10 new songs

* Added an extra Minigame discarded from Jiggies of Time

* 10 Jiggies have been added (+ 1 extra final Jiggy) Total: 21

* 5 more Mumbo Tokens. Total: 20

* 10 more Empty honeycombs. Total: 12

* Reduced the notes to 125 to fix a bug in the Select file screen note counting

* More dialogues and previous dialogues rewritten

* And more surprises...
